name: PMC3517200-worn-dentition-opg
source: Figure 1(b) pre-treatment panoramic radiograph from ‘Prosthodontic Rehabilitation of a Bruxer Patient with Severely Worn Dentition: A Clinical Case Report,’ Farhang Mahboub, Elnaz Moslehi Fard, Farideh Geramipanah and Habib Hajimiragha, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3517200/. Licensed CC BY 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Image reproduced unchanged. Reported plan: full-mouth metal-ceramic crowns on all remaining natural teeth plus a mandibular Kennedy class II removable partial denture, with cast gold posts/cores on endodontically treated teeth; no implants.

intake.freeText: I have very worn down teeth — they look really short and my bite feels collapsed. I also have some missing back teeth on the lower jaw. Everything is sensitive and I am embarrassed to smile. What can be done to fix my teeth?
